text:
Alice: Quick heads-up — planning a region-staggered rollout for release v2.4.1 tonight: US -> EU -> APAC. Window starts 23:00 PDT. Need final capacity checks and a pin/rollback plan.
Ben: Ack. What's the pinned model binary/version we should stick to if we need to hold traffic?
Carla: Pin to v2.4.1-rc3 artifact (sha: a1b2c3d). This has the latency fix but still under light perf tests.
Dave: Can we keep US at 50% traffic for first 20m, then 100% if healthy?
Erin: +1. Suggest warm pool at 120 GPUs in US, EU warm pool 60 before cutover, APAC 40. Those are reserves to avoid evictions.
SRE_Oncall: Values look fine. Current available: US 150 GPUs, EU 90, APAC 55 (after other teams' reservations). We can provision burst +20 in EU if needed but lead time ~10m.
Ben: DeployBot — run a dry-canary across US with 10% traffic, 10m evaluation, release notes link, and automatic rollback on 3x error-rate spike.
DeployBot: deploy start | env=prod-us | artifact=v2.4.1-rc3 | slice=canary-10pct | eval=10m | rollback_on=error:3x
Alice: Good. Also add a performance gate: 95th ms latency not exceed baseline +50ms for 10m.
DeployBot: gate updated | latency_95p <= baseline+50ms | error_rate <= baseline*3
Carla: Callout — quantized variant (q8) is in the mix for EU. If EU performance dips we should fallback to fp16 pinned variant.
Dave: Noted — fallback policy: EU -> fallback_model: v2.4.1-rc3-fp16 (pinned) if latency or error thresholds fail for 2 consecutive 5m windows.
Erin: I pushed the rollout doc and post-deploy checklist: https://go/redwood/releases/v2.4.1/checklist (contains smoke tests and eval prompt set).
Ben: Running a quick smoke test matrix against canary in US: 50 concurrent sessions, embed throughput check, streaming latency. I'll post results in 8m.
SRE_Oncall: Alerting: set temporary SLO slack channel #releases-v2.4.1 and enable paging on 2x error rate.
Alice: @SRE_Oncall please coordinate with infra to keep deploybot throttle cap at 500 qps for canary.
SRE_Oncall: Throttle cap set to 500 qps for canary slice. I'll monitor headroom.
DeployBot: canary metrics snapshot: time=+5m | error_rate=0.2% | latency_95p=120ms (baseline 90ms) | qps=420
Ben: Looks okay but 95p is +30ms, still under +50ms gate. Continue to 10m.
DeployBot: canary metrics snapshot: time=+10m | error_rate=0.25% | latency_95p=125ms | qps=460 | gate=PASS
Alice: Proceed US progressive ramp to 100% over 30m with 3 min step increases. Keep EU and APAC pinned.
DeployBot: rollout schedule queued: US ramp 10%->100% over 30m | EU hold | APAC hold
Carla: Before EU start, we should run a capacity smoke: 200 concurrent sessions targeting EU warm pool, ensure no OOMs and no eviction spikes. Who owns that test?
Dave: Ops can run it. I'll kick off load script: 
```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 5m scripts/eu_smoke.js --env TARGET=eu
```
Dave: Starting now. ETA 7m.
DeployBot: EU warm pool pre-check: available_gpus=90 | reserved_for_other=30 | free_for_rollout=60 | warm_pool_target=60 | result=OK
Dave: Smoke done — no OOM, 95p latency steady at 135ms, errors 0.3%. Passing smoke.
Erin: Great. EU rollout window 00:40 PDT (01:40 MDT) — we should start EU canary at 20% for 10m then decide.
Alice: Agree. APAC follow ~90m after EU start, with smaller warm pool (40) and conservative ramp.
Ben: One more: release notes mention a model kernel change that can increase memory use by ~5-8% under long-context jobs. Flagging to support team.
Carla: We'll include a quick eval filter to catch long-context jobs and route to a lower-context variant if mem > threshold. Policy: if mem_usage>80% then route to v2.4.1-rc3-lowctx.
SRE_Oncall: Noted. I'll add an eviction watch and set a paging rule if mem_pressure>85% sustained for 3m.
DeployBot: EU canary start | env=prod-eu | artifact=v2.4.1-rc3-q8 | slice=canary-20pct | eval=10m
DeployBot: EU canary metrics @+5m | error_rate=0.28% | latency_95p=140ms | qps=180 | gate=PASS
Ben: EU gate pass. Proceed EU ramp to 100% over 25m, but if mem_pressure climbs >75% slow the ramp.
Alice: APAC scheduled at 02:30 PDT. Keep pin for APAC to sha a1b2c3d until APAC canary passes.
Dave: I'll pre-warm APAC to 45 GPUs at +15m before start to account for provisioning lag.
Erin: Logging: make sure the release tag v2.4.1 is in telemetry and we capture prompt-set eval IDs.
DeployBot: APAC prewarm queued | goal=45GPUs | start_in=15m
SRE_Oncall: During US ramp we saw an unexpected spike in behind-the-scenes cache-thrashing for a subset of requests (nonblocking). I recommend watching redis miss-rate.
Carla: Added a quick cache-metric alert: redis_miss_rate > 15% sustained 5m -> page infra.
Ben: If any region fails gate, plan is: immediate pin to v2.4.1-rc3 and automatic rollback to last stable (v2.4.0) if metrics worsen after pin for 10m. Manual approval required for full rollback across regions.
Alice: Confirming rollback decision flow. Also postmortem owner assignment: if we roll back, SRE_Oncall + Carla will own postmortem.
SRE_Oncall: Understood. I'll be standing by.
DeployBot: US rollout complete | success=true | final_metrics: error_rate=0.3% | latency_95p=118ms | rollforward=true
Alice: Nice work team. EU ramp finishing now. Next: APAC prewarm and start per schedule. I'll update #releases-v2.4.1 with final notes and the canary graphs. :shipit:
Erin: I'll run the regression eval overnight and post results.
Dave: Leaving a runbook snippet here for follow-up ops: 
```
If region_fallback triggered:
  1) pin traffic to artifact a1b2c3d
  2) notify #releases-v2.4.1 and page SRE_Oncall
  3) if metrics don't improve in 10m -> execute rollback to v2.4.0
```
Alice: Thanks. Closing thread after APAC green.
Ben: Thx everyone :thumbsup:
